problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate a fixed budget across 15 different infrastructure projects to maximize the total expected community benefit.  
The profile for each project is as follows:  
* Project A: expected benefit is 0.044, impact score is 0.047, allocation limits [0.019, 0.599]  
* Project B: expected benefit is 0.162, impact score is 0.051, allocation limits [0.099, 0.396]  
* Project C: expected benefit is 0.134, impact score is 0.089, allocation limits [0.098, 0.854]  
* Project D: expected benefit is 0.088, impact score is 0.141, allocation limits [0.062, 0.332]  
* Project E: expected benefit is 0.048, impact score is 0.079, allocation limits [0.086, 0.519]  
* Project F: expected benefit is 0.178, impact score is 0.061, allocation limits [0.099, 0.426]  
* Project G: expected benefit is 0.035, impact score is 0.211, allocation limits [0.051, 0.451]  
* Project H: expected benefit is 0.021, impact score is 0.183, allocation limits [0.046, 0.670]  
* Project I: expected benefit is 0.187, impact score is 0.218, allocation limits [0.063, 0.834]  
* Project J: expected benefit is 0.147, impact score is 0.187, allocation limits [0.021, 0.572]  
* Project K: expected benefit is 0.127, impact score is 0.036, allocation limits [0.005, 0.363]  
* Project L: expected benefit is 0.071, impact score is 0.250, allocation limits [0.011, 0.331]  
* Project M: expected benefit is 0.145, impact score is 0.097, allocation limits [0.015, 0.622]  
* Project N: expected benefit is 0.163, impact score is 0.131, allocation limits [0.084, 0.395]  
* Project O: expected benefit is 0.106, impact score is 0.172, allocation limits [0.091, 0.317]  

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified limits, and the total allocation across all projects must sum to one. To ensure timely completion, the set of quick-delivery projects Q = {H, J} must together receive at least 0.092 of the total budget. Additionally, the overall impact score of the portfolio must not exceed 0.134, and the total expected benefit must be at least 0.105. Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total expected benefit while satisfying all constraints.
